title: Sparkly violin
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='body' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#f0a24a'/>
      <stop offset='0.5' stop-color='#ffcf7a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#e58a2e'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='neck' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#a8601e'/>
      <stop offset='0.5' stop-color='#cf8840'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#9c5518'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- violin body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='20' ry='17' fill='url(#body)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='16' ry='14' fill='url(#body)'/>
  <!-- waist highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='13' ry='5' fill='#ffd98f' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- f holes -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='52' rx='2' ry='7' fill='#7a3e0c'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='52' rx='2' ry='7' fill='#7a3e0c'/>
  <!-- bridge -->
  <rect x='44' y='58' width='12' height='3.5' rx='1.5' fill='#fff1cf'/>
  <!-- tailpiece -->
  <path d='M46 72 L54 72 L52 82 L48 82 Z' fill='#7a3e0c'/>
  <!-- chin rest feel: small highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#ffd98f' opacity='0.45'/>

  <!-- neck and fingerboard -->
  <rect x='47' y='20' width='6' height='24' rx='2' fill='url(#neck)'/>
  <rect x='48.5' y='22' width='3' height='20' rx='1.5' fill='#5a320c'/>
  <!-- strings -->
  <line x1='48' y1='22' x2='48' y2='78' stroke='#fff3d8' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='22' x2='50' y2='78' stroke='#fff3d8' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='52' y1='22' x2='52' y2='78' stroke='#fff3d8' stroke-width='0.8'/>

  <!-- scroll -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='17' r='5' fill='#a8601e'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='17' r='2.4' fill='#ffcf7a'/>
  <!-- pegs -->
  <rect x='44' y='23' width='3' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#3b220a'/>
  <rect x='53' y='27' width='3' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#3b220a'/>
  <rect x='44' y='31' width='3' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#3b220a'/>
  <rect x='53' y='35' width='3' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#3b220a'/>

  <!-- bow across strings -->
  <line x1='30' y1='62' x2='75' y2='44' stroke='#d8b07a' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='30' y1='62' x2='75' y2='44' stroke='#fff6e0' stroke-width='0.6'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#fff6a8'>
    <path d='M18 26 l1.6 4 4 1.6 -4 1.6 -1.6 4 -1.6 -4 -4 -1.6 4 -1.6 Z'/>
    <path d='M82 30 l1.4 3.4 3.4 1.4 -3.4 1.4 -1.4 3.4 -1.4 -3.4 -3.4 -1.4 3.4 -1.4 Z'/>
    <path d='M78 78 l1.3 3.2 3.2 1.3 -3.2 1.3 -1.3 3.2 -1.3 -3.2 -3.2 -1.3 3.2 -1.3 Z'/>
    <path d='M20 80 l1.4 3.4 3.4 1.4 -3.4 1.4 -1.4 3.4 -1.4 -3.4 -3.4 -1.4 3.4 -1.4 Z'/>
    <circle cx='34' cy='30' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='68' cy='22' r='1.4'/>
    <circle cx='86' cy='58' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='14' cy='56' r='1.4'/>
    <circle cx='60' cy='88' r='1.4'/>
    <circle cx='40' cy='88' r='1.2'/>
  </g>
</svg>
